name: Trybe Summer Jobs and Paid Internships (East Oakland)
what_you_do: Skills building, leadership training and paid internships for East Bay youth. In the City's summer jobs list, Trybe offers a 100 hour summer job for East Oakland youth.
who_can_apply: East Bay youth. Trybe's old 2022 posting asked for age 16 or older with photo ID and SSN or ITIN, and offered a stipend option for under 16. Current rules are not posted.
pay_detail: City of Oakland's 2026 list says paid, 100 hours, at least Oakland minimum wage. Trybe's own 2022 posting said $15.06 per hour (old).
deadline_text: No current dates posted. The old 2022 posting took applications until May 31.
how_to_apply: Call (510) 985-9915 or email info@oaklandtrybe.org. Trybe also has a Jobs/Internships page on its site.
notes: Trybe's free summer camp is for kids 0 to 14; the paid youth internship is separate and the summer page shows only a flyer with no details. Call to ask about 2027. Do not confuse oaklandtrybe.org with trybe.org.
